digest.component_or_area: plan review gate / LLM command surfaces
propositions: A plan review that passes but whose attestation signature fails to persist must be classified as retryable, not success.
The retry/cause classification logic currently exists only in CLI (_cli/_llm_commands.py) but not in MCP (_mcp_llm.py), causing agents to see PASS verdict and fail at the claim gate.
The MCP surface returns raw review_plan result without inspecting signature or discriminating transient vs persistent failure.
The sign_review recovery capability is already exposed over MCP but agents are not informed it is needed.
Retryable classification must be extracted into a shared location below both CLI and MCP surfaces to ensure consistent behavior.
The CLI must continue mapping the classifier to exit 11 with identical stderr, and MCP must return a structured retryable flag naming sign_review as recovery.
